issue_title: A public handler class cannot be imported from the package entry point
issue_body: A handler class that is part of the package's public API cannot be imported from the package's top level: importing it yields undefined, even though the same class is available from an internal path. Other handler classes from the same package import from the top level correctly.
prompt: A handler class that is part of the package's public API cannot be imported from the package's top level: importing it yields undefined, even though the same class is available from an internal path. Other handler classes from the same package import from the top level correctly.
expected_behavior: Existing exports (Agent, Client, Pool, etc.) are unchanged.
DecoratorHandler works correctly when imported from the top level.
